content.short: Bounce.Tech offers leveraged tokens on crypto, memecoins and stocks without liquidation risk.
content.description: Bounce.Tech issues leveraged tokens backed by Hyperliquid perpetuals, covering ETH, BTC, memecoins and tokenized stocks. A holder gets leveraged exposure by holding a token, with no position to margin and no liquidation price to monitor. The perps backing each token supply the leverage, and other applications can list the tokens directly.
content.meta: Leveraged exposure to crypto, memecoins and equities in token form, with no liquidation price.
